instruction: Cinematic medium shot of an indoor sports gymnasium with wooden floors. In the center, the young girl in a pink tracksuit (R5) stands supported by three coaches. The bearded man in a dark grey t-shirt (R4) kneels on the left, holding her right hand. The man with an afro (R1) in a white t-shirt kneels on the right, holding her left hand. Behind her, the red-haired woman in a black top (R3) stands and supports her waist. Warm indoor light filters through the windows, illuminating the group and casting soft shadows.
